plan.title: Dawn Relay
plan.grammar: A Scene-driven routing puzzle: choose the correct branch for three incoming signals in sequence; correct choices advance and wrong choices leave the operator at the current relay.
plan.startup: The ordinary title Scene enters three menu Scenes that constitute the whole game.
plan.playableProof: Choose Begin, then route Amber to North, Blue to Archive, and Green to North to reach the completed relay Scene.
plan.contentBudget: Five tiny menu Scenes plus the neutral unused map Scene. No RPG databases.
